parsed.post: Discarding 1.0275; it was a significant regression. Reverting to my best: DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.02, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05. Since agent-3 and agent-8 found that LR=0.01 is too low for depth-8, and agent-1/2/4 found success with LR=0.02, I'll try increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to stabilize the initial steps.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 on the best DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.02 configuration to improve training stability during the early phase.
